blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
The emergence of foundation models for molecular property prediction requires a high degree of AI data readiness, including reliable metadata annotation. However, both public repositories and industrial screening databases suffer from missing, inconsistent, or conflated assay annotations. In this work, we quantify the extent of missing annotations in PubChem for the BioAssay Ontology (BAO) assay format and physical detection method fields and investigate whether open-source and proprietary large language models (LLMs) can reliably predict and audit metadata annotations directly from the assay text.
In our assessment, we found that the annotation coverage across PubChem’s ∼ \sim 2 million bioassays is critically sparse, 36% lacking an assay format, 89% a BioAssay type, and >99.9% any BAO-mapped assay format or detection technology term. This motivates the need for automated test-metadata curation. Using evaluation sets derived from PubChem and ChEMBL, we assess the agreement of seven open-source and proprietary LLMs with existing silver labels. Recall is at least 0.96 for biochemical and cell-based assay formats, with a similar pattern for detection technology, although disagreements increase on under-represented classes. Manual inspection shows that many of these disagreements trace back to inconsistencies between silver sources rather than to LLM error. Moreover, in a qualitative study with a senior industrial curator, LLM-generated evidence prompted the expert to revise some of their own labels, showing LLMs can flag potentially mislabeled assays. Across the study, performance differences between proprietary and open-source models were small. Together, these results suggest LLMs can support the large-scale annotation and auditing of assay metadata, though per-class reliability estimates and targeted human review remain necessary before such labels enter downstream ML pipelines.
blocks.zh:
分子属性预测的基础模型的出现需要高度的AI数据准备,包括可靠的元数据注释. 然而,公共储存库和工业筛选数据库都存在缺失、不一致或拼凑的化验说明。 在这项工作中,我们量化了PubChem中缺少的生物分析本体学(BAO)分析格式和物理检测方法字段说明的程度,并调查开源和专有的大语言模型(LLMs)是否能够可靠地直接从分析文本中预测和审计元数据说明.
在我们的评估中,我们发现PubChem的200万份生物测定的注解覆盖范围极为稀少,36%没有测定格式,89%是生物测定类型,而>99.9%是BAO测定格式或检测技术术语。 这就促使需要自动化的测试元数据校验。 我们利用从PubChem和ChEMBL得出的评价集,评估七个开源和专有LLMs与现有银标签的一致。 生物化学和细胞检测格式的召回至少为0.96,检测技术模式相似,尽管代表性不足的类别出现分歧。 手工检查表明,其中许多分歧可追溯到银源之间的不一致,而不是LLM错误。 此外,在与一位高级工业主管进行的一项定性研究中,LLM生成的证据促使专家修改了他们自己的一些标签,表明LLMs可以标出可能误标的化验结果。 在整个研究中,专有模式和开源模式之间的性能差异很小。 这些结果表明,LLMs可以支持对化验元数据进行大规模说明和审计,尽管在这种标签进入下游ML管道之前,仍然需要按类别进行可靠性估计和有针对性的人审查。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
The FAIR data principles [ 22 ] introduced standards to make data findable, accessible, interoperable, and reusable, yet AI readiness for many datasets remains limited. In particular, missing, inconsistent, and incorrect metadata remain widespread problems in scientific data repositories.
Bioassay collections are a notable example and a fundamental source of data for machine learning models for drug discovery.
blocks.zh:
FAIR数据原则[22]引入了标准,使数据可以查找、可访问、互操作和可重复使用,然而AI对许多数据集的准备程度仍然有限。 特别是,缺少、不一致和不正确的元数据仍然是科学数据储存库中普遍存在的问题。
生物测定收集是一个显著的例子,也是药物发现机器学习模型的基本数据来源。

blocks.en: A bioassay measures the effect of a substance on a biological system to obtain insight into the expected biological activity. PubChem [ 11 ] is the largest public chemical database, containing more than 100 million compounds and bioassay results from more than a million assays. Many entries lack structured metadata on the nature of the experiment, such as the assay format and the detection method. The lack of metadata in PubChem reflects issues such as records that predate relevant standards or inconsistent use of terminology among contributors. Industrial assay databases present related problems, including missing historical data and the use of single labels, such as the “assay category” to describe several distinct aspects of an assay at once.
blocks.zh: 生物测定测量一种物质对生物系统的影响,以了解预期的生物活动。 PubChem [11]是最大的公共化学数据库,包含超过1亿种化合物和100多万种化验结果的生物测定结果. 许多条目缺乏关于实验性质的结构化元数据,如化验格式和检测方法. PubChem缺乏元数据,反映了在相关标准之前的记录等问题,或者撰稿人对术语的使用不一致. 工业分析数据库存在相关问题,包括缺少历史数据和使用单一标签,例如“分析类别”一并描述分析的若干不同方面。

blocks.en: The BioAssay Ontology (BAO) [ 20 , 1 ] addresses the ambiguity challenge by decomposing assays into orthogonal axes, including the biological format and the physical detection method, the endpoint measured and the target with each a formal class definition. This distinction allows for assays of the same format but with a different detection method to be distinguished. It aims to provide a framework for mapping unstructured descriptions to standardized entities. PubChem’s native “BioAssay Type” field mixes format, modality, and endpoint into composite labels such as In vivo|Toxicity or Cell-based|RNAi for instance. Disentangling such labels retroactively or filling in missing labels manually does not scale to the level of millions of PubChem records or decades of legacy industrial assays.
blocks.zh: 生物分析肿瘤学[20,1]通过将化验分解成正弦轴,包括生物格式和物理检测方法、测量的终点和每个正式分类定义的目标,来解决模糊性的挑战。 这种区分允许对相同格式但具有不同检测方法的化验加以区分。 它旨在为向标准化实体绘制非结构化说明提供一个框架。 PubChem 本地的“ BioAssay Type ” 字段将格式、模式和端点混合到复合标签中, 例如 In vivo_Toxicity 或 Cell- based_RNAi 。 追溯取消这种标签或手工填写缺失的标签,不会达到百万PubChem记录或几十年遗留的工业鉴定的水平。

blocks.en: Large language models offer a promising approach to close this gap. For instance, instruction-tuned LLMs have recently been shown to perform well on ontology alignment in biomedical fields [ 4 , 10 ] . Nevertheless, their performance on ontologies with multiple dimensions, such as BAO, remains underexplored. We address this gap by evaluating LLMs on the assignment of BAO assay formats and assay detection methods.
blocks.zh: 大型语言模式为弥合这一差距提供了一个很有希望的办法。 例如,最近证明,在生物医学领域,经指导调整的LLMs在肿瘤学协调方面表现良好[4、10]。 尽管如此,它们在具有多个维度的本体学方面的表现,如BAO,仍然没有得到充分的探讨. 我们通过评估关于指定BAO化验格式和化验检测方法的法学硕士课程来弥补这一差距。

blocks.en: Our contributions can be summarized as: (i) a systematic analysis of missing and inconsistent assay format and detection technique metadata in PubChem BioAssay’s bulk-download distribution, (ii) an assessment of four open-source and three closed-source LLMs on text-conditioned BAO assay format classification, using ChEMBL cross-references as a reference label followed by further exploration for physical detection method and subsets of PubChem and (iii) manual review of LLM vs. current-label disagreement, further backed up by a curator, in which we found examples of a senior industrial curator agreeing with the LLM over the original dataset label. Together, these results show that LLMs can detect likely mislabeled assays and in the future support automated annotation 1 1 1 Code and data will be publicly released upon acceptance of the full paper. .
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献可以归纳为:(一) 对PubChem BioAssay批量下载量分布中缺失和不一致的化验格式和检测技术元数据进行系统分析;(二) 对四个开源和三个闭源LLMs进行文字条件BAO化验格式分类评估,将ChEMBL交叉参照作为参考标签,然后进一步探索PubChem的物理检测方法和子集;(三) 手动审查LLM对当前标签的分歧,进一步得到一位主管的支持,我们在其中发现了一位高级工业主管同意LLM关于原始数据集标签的例子。 这些结果表明,LLMs可以检测到可能存在标签错误的化验结果,并且在未来支持自动注释1,11代码,数据将在接受完整论文后公开发布. 。 。 。

blocks.en: 2 Background and Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 背景和有关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Bioassay Ontology (BAO)
blocks.zh: 2.1 生物分析肿瘤学

blocks.en: The BioAssay Ontology (BAO) was introduced to give the output of high-throughput screening campaigns explicit description-logic semantics rather than free-text labels [ 20 ] , and later extended and modernized to cover a wider range of assay types and to interoperate with adjacent ontologies (cell line, target, and unit vocabularies) [ 1 ] . The BAO model focuses on subdividing assays into orthogonal axes, including categories related to the bioassay component, biology, endpoint, format, and method component. However, achieving comprehensive coverage of all bioassays has proved challenging. For example, in 2014, BAO could not adequately represent all transporter assays in ChEMBL [ 24 ] . Since then, it has undergone numerous updates to expand its capacity to describe and categorize diverse assay types. The current version (uploaded on the 6th of May 2026 v2.8.19 ) contains 7918 separate classes 2 2 2 http://www.bioassayontology.org/ and is a product of over a decade of iterative validation against real-world chemical biology datasets.
blocks.zh: 生物分析肿瘤学(BAO)的推出是为了使高通量筛选运动的产出明确描述-逻辑语义而不是自由文字标签[20],后来加以扩展和现代化,以涵盖更广泛的分析类型,并与相邻的肿瘤学(细胞线、目标和单位词汇)进行相互协作。 [1]. BAO模型侧重于将化验分解成正交轴,包括与生物测定成分、生物学、终点、格式和方法成分有关的类别。 然而,全面涵盖所有生物分析已证明具有挑战性。 例如,2014年,BAO无法在CHEMBL [24]中充分代表所有运输商的化验. 此后,它经历了多次更新,以扩大其描述和分类各种化验类型的能力。 目前版本(上载于2026年5月6日 v2.8.19 )包含7918个单独类 2 2 2 http://www.bioassayontology.org/,是十年多迭代验证实域化学生物学数据集的产物.

blocks.en: Early efforts to apply BAO relied on manual annotation. [ 19 ] manually annotated 944 PubChem assays using a drop-down menu. They showed that they could map 299 distinct PubChem names to 20 controlled BAO terms, demonstrating the potential of the ontology to reduce terminological ambiguity and reveal additional relationships between assays. Industry has also adopted the BAO framework. AstraZeneca utilized this framework to annotate 381 internal assays run from 2005–2013, along with 233 PubChem assays to get insight into the technology gaps between their internal screening and external screening, compare compound–activity overlap and flag technology-specific artifacts [ 23 ] . However, manual annotation of protocols remains laborious and does not scale to the millions of bioassays available in public data repositories.
blocks.zh: 早期应用BAO的努力依赖于人工注释. [19] 手动注解 944 PubChem 使用下拉菜单的化验. 它们表明,它们可以将299个不同的PubChem名称映射到20个受控制的BAO术语,表明本体学在减少术语模糊性,揭示分析之间更多的关系方面的潜力. 工业界还采用了BAO框架。 AstraZeneca利用这个框架对2005-2013年的381份内部化验以及233份PubChem化验进行了注释,以了解其内部筛选和外部筛选之间的技术差距,比较复合活动重叠和旗帜技术专用文物[23]。 然而,人工说明协议仍然很费力,没有扩大到公共数据储存库提供的数百万份生物化验。

blocks.en: 2.2 Annotated public data repositories
blocks.zh: 2.2 附加说明的公共数据储存库

blocks.en: In this work, we use three sources of bioassay annotations: PubChem, ChEMBL and BARD. PubChem [ 11 ] is the most extensive collection of publicly available data from high-throughput screening and medicinal chemistry experiments, which contains descriptions of protocols, target and results that many screening laboratories, biotech, pharmaceutical companies, and academic institutions have deposited since 2004 [ 21 ] , currently comprising ∼ \sim 1.9M bioassays (AIDs) as of the 2026 bulk download. However, records vary greatly on how and if the experimental metadata was reported, and often the information is present in form of unstructured free-text.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们使用三种生物测定说明来源:PubChem、ChenBL和BARD。 PubChem [11] 是从高通量筛选和药用化学实验中最广泛收集的公开数据,其中包含了许多筛选实验室,生物技术,制药公司和学术机构自2004年以来保存的协议,目标和结果的描述[21],目前包括 \\sim 1.9M 生物测定(AIDs)截至2026年的批量下载. 然而,在实验元数据是如何和是否报告的方面,记录差异很大,信息往往以无结构的自由文本的形式出现.

blocks.en: To address this, the BioAssay Research Database (BARD) [ 9 ] produced a curated set of BAO annotations on PubChem records from the NIH Molecular Libraries Program (MLP). Curators mapped free-text PubChem protocols onto BAO terms, and the annotations were reviewed by MLP scientists involved in the original experiments. Although the BARD portal has been retired, its 4 477 curated annotations for 1 000 assays remain available in PubChem [ 14 ] as a bulk download. Out of these assays 997 have an annotated detection method and 998 had an annotated assay format. The BARD annotations for these assays and some assays beyond this, appear under the “BioAssay Annotations”.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这一问题,生物分析研究数据库[9]制作了一套关于NIH分子图书馆方案的PubChem记录的BAO说明。 控制器将自由文本的PubChem协议映射到BAO术语上,说明被参与原始实验的MLP科学家审查. 虽然BARD门户网站已退役,但其4,477条编译说明的1000条化验内容仍作为批量下载在PubChem[14]提供. 在这些检验中,997有附加说明的检测方法,998有附加说明的检测格式。 有关这些化验和一些化验的BARD说明载于“BioAssay说明”。

blocks.en: ChEMBL, in turn, is a manually curated bioactivity database that collects bioactivity data extracted primarily from the scientific literature [ 6 , 13 ] and based on voluntary data depositors comprising ∼ \sim 2.0M assays. ChEMBL curators assign standardized assay and target metadata and link some records to PubChem assay ID (AID) identifiers, an independent source of reference annotations for a subset of PubChem assays. ChEMBL has also introduced direct-deposition workflows with structured submission formats, depositor-defined identifiers, and validation procedures, aimed at improving metadata consistency [ 13 , 25 ] . Nevertheless, many of these annotations lack meaningful BAO terms; ∼ \sim 10% of the assays have unspecified assay formats, detection-method labels are entirely absent, and some existing annotations were generated using rule-based methods that may be unreliable [ 16 ] .
blocks.zh: ChEMBL又是一个人工整理的生物活性数据库,主要收集从科学文献中提取的生物活性数据[6,13],并基于包含\\sim 2.0M分析的自愿数据存储器. ChEMBL 管理员指定标准化的测定和目标元数据,并将一些记录与 PubChem asy ID (AID) 标识符连接起来,这是 PubChem sessions 的一个子集的参考说明的独立来源. CEMBL还引入了具有结构化提交格式、储量器定义标识符和验证程序的直接沉降工作流程,目的是提高元数据的一致性[13、25]。 尽管如此,许多这些说明缺乏有意义的BAO术语;\\sim 10%的化验有未指明的化验格式,检测方法标签完全不存在,一些现有的说明是使用可能不可靠的基于规则的方法生成的[16].

blocks.en: These three annotation sources differ not only in their coverage of assays and metadata coverage but also in the way their labels are produced. Native PubChem metadata are derived from voluntary, free-text depositor submissions and have been found to lack the consistent structure needed for cross-assay comparison [ 9 ] . ChEMBL improves on this through expert bioactivity curation, although the metadata coverage is limited. BARD was purpose-built for accuracy, and its expert validation step is absent from both PubChem’s native fields and ChEMBL’s assay annotations to our knowledge. However it only covers a small subset of PubChem. For assays annotated in all three sources, we therefore treat BARD-derived labels as the most trustworthy reference, ChEMBL as a secondary also partial source, and native PubChem metadata as the least reliable baseline.
blocks.zh: 这三个注解来源不仅在说明和元数据覆盖的覆盖面方面,而且在标签制作方式方面也有所不同。 土生土长的PubChem元数据来源于自愿提交的自由文本存储器,并被发现缺乏交叉分析比较所需的一致结构[9]. CEMBL通过专家的生物活性分析改进了这方面的工作,尽管元数据的覆盖面有限。 BARD是专为准确性而设计的,它的专家验证步骤没有出现在PubChem的原生地和ChEMBL对我们知识的描述中。 然而它只涵盖一个小子集PubChem. 对于所有三个来源的注解分析,我们因此将BARD衍生的标签作为最可靠的参考,将CHEMBL作为次要的也是部分来源,将原生的PubChem元数据作为最不可靠的基线。

blocks.en:
Because of these reliability gaps, several groups have built curated subsets or rule-based cleanup pipelines rather than fixing annotations at the source. Curated benchmarks such as LIT-PCBA [ 18 ] and MF-PCBA [ 3 ] clean HTS data and discard unreliable records, while ScrubChem applies logic-based text-processing rules to curate PubChem [ 8 ] . More recently, CAPRICHO [ 2 ] addressed curation of ChEMBL bioactivity data for QSAR modeling by flagging quality issues rather than removing them, letting users assess how each curation decision impacts the results.
Its case studies show that assay metadata strongly affects whether measurements can be combined: grouping by assay type and cell type improved cross-assay agreement.
However, CAPRICHO relies on existing ChEMBL metadata fields and on keyword-based queries of free-text assay descriptions. This highlights the need for more complete and structured assay annotations, which we address here using LLMs.
blocks.zh:
由于存在这些可靠性差距,一些团体已经建立了整理的子集或基于规则的清理管道,而不是在源头固定说明. LIT-PCBA[18]和MF-PCBA[3]清洁HTS数据和丢弃不可靠的记录等被破解的基准,而ScrubChem则应用基于逻辑的文本处理规则对PubChem[8]进行破解. 最近,CAPRICHO[2]通过标出质量问题,而不是去除质量问题,解决了对CHEMBL生物活动数据进行计量的问题,使用户评估每项计量决定如何影响结果。
其案例研究表明,元数据分析对计量是否可合并有重大影响:通过分析类型和细胞类型分组,改进了交叉分析协议。
然而,CAPRICHO依赖于现有的ChEMBL元数据字段和基于关键词的对自由文本描述的查询. 这突出说明了需要更加完整和有条理的试验说明,我们在此使用法学硕士课程加以论述。

blocks.en: Overall, although public repositories contain millions of bioassays, their BAO annotations are often missing, incomplete or unreliable, motivating the development of scalable, automated annotation methods.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,虽然公共储存库中含有数百万种生物分析,但其BAO说明往往缺失、不完整或不可靠,从而推动了可扩展、自动注释方法的发展。

blocks.en: 2.3 Bioassay curation with language models
blocks.zh: 2.3 语言模型生物测定法

blocks.en: LLMs offer a promising approach to automated assay annotation. LLMs are increasingly used to extract metadata from biomedical records. For example, ChIP-GPT uses a LLaMA-based model to extract chromatin immunoprecipitation metadata from free-text records [ 4 ] . Similarly, [ 10 ] used Llama 3 to extract cell line and gene perturbation terms from BioSample descriptions. In both studies, the LLM method outperformed the traditional mapping approach. For assay format annotation specifically, recent studies have explored AI-assisted pipelines. One approach uses a named entity recognition (NER) model to extract the assay type from a curated description, followed by text2term [ 7 ] to ground free-text metadata to biomedical ontology terms [ 16 ] . Other methods, including a retrieval-then-prompt framework [ 17 , 12 ] and other similar pipelines such as RELATE [ 15 ] , ground LLM outputs to formal ontology terms rather than free text. This helps address a common issue with LLMs: their tendency to generate non-standard labels. To our knowledge, whether the same strategies could reliably assign BAO labels (i.e., format, detection, target) from free text consistently is unexplored and we aim to address this gap.
blocks.zh: 有限责任公司为自动说明提供了一种很有希望的办法。 LLMs越来越多地用于从生物医学记录中提取元数据. 例如,ChIP-GPT使用基于LLaMA的模型从自由文本记录中提取铬免疫降水元数据[4]. 同样,[10]使用Llama 3从BioSample描述中提取细胞线和基因扰动术语. 在这两项研究中,LLM方法的性能都超过了传统的绘图方法. 特别是就说明格式而言,最近的研究探索了人工智能辅助管道。 一种方法使用一个命名的实体识别(NER)模型,从一个解析的描述中提取实验类型,然后是文本2term [7],将自由文本元数据地面到生物医学本体学术语[16]. 其他方法,包括一个检索-当时即时的框架[17,12]和其他类似的管道,如RELATE[15],地面LLM输出到正式的本体学术语而不是自由文本. 这有助于解决LLMS的一个共同问题:它们产生非标准标签的倾向. 据我们所知,同样的战略是否能够可靠地从自由文本中指定BAO的标签(即格式、检测、目标),这一点尚未加以探讨,我们的目标是解决这一差距。

blocks.en: 3 Methods
blocks.zh: 3个 方法

blocks.en:
To evaluate the performance of LLMs for predicting bioassay metadata classes, we constructed our dataset from the PubChem BioAssay bulk JSON data and combined this with the associated annotations of assays and comment files (detailed in Appendix A ). This process yielded
1 770 568 AIDs (containing a name, comment, and/or description) out
of 1 994 310 downloaded in total. Because some metadata fields were empty or missing in the bulk files despite being available through the PubChem web interface, we additionally queried PubChem’s PUG REST endpoint for the assays included in our analysis. We used the returned records to supplement the assay title, description, comments and protocol when available.
blocks.zh:
为了评估LLMS用于预测生物测定元数据类别的性能,我们从PubChem BioAssay 批量的JSON数据中构建了我们的数据集,并将其与相关分析说明和评论文件(详见附录A)结合起来。 这一过程产生了
1 770 568 AID(包含名称、注释和/或描述) 退出
共下载1 994 310次。 由于一些元数据字段虽然可以通过 PubChem 网络界面获得,但仍是空的或散装文件中缺失的,我们进一步询问 PubChem 的 PUG REST 端点,以了解我们分析中包含的检验结果。 我们使用归还的记录来补充分析标题、描述、评论和协议。

blocks.en: We also queried the ChEMBL 37 database 3 3 3 https://ftp.ebi.ac.uk/pub/databases/ChEMBL/ChEMBLdb/releases/ChEMBL_37/ChEMBL_37_sqlite.tar.gz and retained records that could be matched to a PubChem assay. We extracted the corresponding BAO assay format annotations, excluded PubChem AIDs that mapped to multiple ChEMBL entries, and discarded entries whose BAO assay format label was assay format . We also removed records with duplicate descriptions to not feed the same text field to the LLM multiple times. We followed the same de-duplication procedure and label cleanup for the AIDs for which BAO assay annotations were available in PubChem but not in ChEMBL. We similarly extracted and filtered data from assays containing physical detection method metadata.
blocks.zh: 我们还询问了ChEMBL 37数据库 3 3 https://ftp.ebi.ac.uk/pub/databases/ChEMBL/ChEMBLdb/releases/ChEMBL_37/ChEMBL_37_sqlite.tar.gz,并保留了可与PubChem分析匹配的记录。 我们提取了相应的 BAO 分析格式说明, 排除了 PubChem AID 绘制到多个 ChEMBL 条目, 并丢弃了 BAO 分析格式标签为 分析格式的条目 。 我们还删除了带有重复描述的记录,以不多次将同一文本字段输入LLM. 我们对AID采取了同样的去重复程序和标签清理,在PubChem有BAO的化验说明,但在CHEMBL没有。 我们同样从包含物理检测方法元数据的分析中提取和过滤数据。

blocks.en: We mapped assay format and physical detection method labels to depth-one categories in the BAO hierarchy (Appendix Fig. 1 and Appendix Fig. 2 ). PubChem and ChEMBL labels that could not be mapped to a depth-one BAO category were discarded. This procedure yielded three final evaluation sets: 1 097 PubChem assays with assay format annotations from ChEMBL, 226 PubChem-only annotated assays with assay format labels, and 308 PubChem assays with physical detection method labels.
blocks.zh: 我们将测试格式和物理检测方法标签映射到BAO等级中的深度1类(附录图1和附录图2)。 无法映射到深度1类的PubChem和ChenBL标签被丢弃。 这一程序产生了三套最后评价:1 097份PubChem化验,附有ChEMBL的化验格式说明;226份PubChem专注的化验,附有化验格式标签;308份PubChem化验,附有物理检测方法标签。

blocks.en: Because the available reference labels are inherited from existing database annotations that included inconsistencies and disagreements with current annotation standards, we refer to them as “silver labels” as they might not reflect the ground truth according to the current BAO system. In this study, silver labels are derived from existing PubChem, ChEMBL, and BioAssay Research Database annotations and are used to evaluate agreement with LLM-generated labels.
blocks.zh: 由于现有的参考标签是从现有的数据库说明中继承下来的,其中包括了与现行注释标准的不一致和分歧,因此我们将其称为“银标签”,因为它们可能无法反映现行BAO系统所规定的基本真相。 本研究中,银色标签来源于现有的PubChem,ChEMBL,以及BioAssay Research Database说明,用于评价与LLM生成的标签的协议.

blocks.en:
We prompt LLMs to predict the assay format or assay physical detection method based on the title, description, comments, and protocol.
We used three proprietary models: GPT-4o, Gemini 3.6 Flash, and Claude Sonnet 4.6, all accessed through APIs. We also evaluated four open-weights models: Gemma 4 31B, GPT-OSS 20B, Qwen 3.5, and Llama 3.3 70B, run locally via Ollama v0.17.4 . Further details on the parameters used to run the models can be found in Appendix F . For prompt-ablation experiments, we selected a stratified subset of 500 assays from the ChEMBL assay format set and evaluated the same assays under different prompt conditions, including alternative label orderings and prompts without the definition of the label. The complete prompts can be found in Appendix E . For models run through Ollama, we enforced the label vocabulary at generation time using Ollama’s JSON-Schema format= parameter.

blocks.en: 4 Missingness and Inconsistency in PubChem Bioassay Metadata
blocks.zh: 4 PubChem生物测定元数据缺失和不一致

blocks.en:
We first investigated the quality and completeness of the metadata provided in the PubChem BioAssay bulk distribution. Out of the 1 994 310 assays in the bulk downloaded, only 89% had a name, description, and comment, with less than 10% unique descriptions. We followed up by analyzing the metadata (see Appendix Table 5 ), focusing specifically on four metadata categories: Assay Format , BAO Assay Format , BAO Detection Technology , and BioAssay Type .
In Appendix A , we report statistics of the distributions across the four metadata dimensions in Tables 6 , 7 , 8 and 9 . The labels show substantial heterogeneity, both in their level of detail and in the aspect of the assay they describe: some refer to the assay modality, others to the endpoint measured. We initially examined the BioAssay Type field to see whether it could inform BAO assay format assignment, but found it unsuitable as the vocabulary conflates format (e.g., Cell-based, Biochemical), methodology (RNAi), and endpoint (Toxicity), and a non-negligible fraction of entries combine multiple labels that are inconsistent with the BAO ontology (Table 9 ).
blocks.zh:
我们首先调查了PubChem BioAssay批量分发所提供的元数据的质量和完整性。 在大量下载的1 994 310份化验中,只有89%有名字、描述和评论,仅有不到10%的独特描述。 我们随后分析了元数据(见附录表5),具体侧重于四个元数据类别: 模拟格式、BAO模拟格式、BAO检测技术和生物测定类型。
附录 我们报告表6、表7、表8和表9中四个元数据的分布情况。 标签在详细程度和所描述的化验方面都显示出相当的异质性:有些提到化验方式,有些提到测量的终点。 我们最初研究了BioAssay Type字段,以了解它是否能够为BAOsay格式指派提供信息,但发现它不合适,因为词汇拼凑了格式(例如基于细胞的,生化的),方法(RNAi)和终点(Toxicity),以及一个不可忽略的分数结合了多个标签,不符合BAO本体(表9).

blocks.en: A related source of variation is the PubChem Assay Format field itself, which offers only three categories (Cell-based, Organism-based, Biochemical), whereas the BAO assay format branch is far richer. This limited vocabulary likely contributes to annotation discrepancies. When curators are forced to pick from three options they may assign a different label than they would given the full BAO hierarchy. This motivates the use of BAO labels for assessing whether LLMs can assign assay formats, instead of using the PubChem Assay Format field itself. We also noticed inconsistencies from the available data in the PubChem web interface. To illustrate, the AID 1885, is reported as Cell-based in the web interface, but as Cell-based|Organism-based in the bulk download. Moreover, inconsistencies can occur within a single PubChem entry: the same assay may be associated with multiple conflicting BAO labels. From the 236 assays that had both the BARD and ChEMBL assay format labels on PubChem in the bulk BARD download, for 24 assays there was a disagreement (10.2%). Further details and case studies can be found in Appendix E.1 . Additionally, the coverage of the metadata fields is limited. The data from the PubChem bulk download present severe amounts of missing data, with 36% out of the 1.9 million entries missing the assay format, and less than 0.1% of the assays having a BAO assay format and physical detection method annotated in the comments.
blocks.zh: 一个相关的变异源是PubChem Assay格式域本身,它只提供三类(基于Cell的,基于Organism的,基于生化的),而BAO测定格式分支则更为丰富. 这种有限的词汇可能会造成注释不一致。 当管理员被迫从三个选项中挑选时,他们可能指定一个不同的标签,而不是赋予他们完整的BAO等级。 这促使人们使用BAO标签来评估LLMS是否可以指定检验格式,而不是使用PubChem Assay格式字段本身. 我们还注意到PubChem网络界面现有数据的不一致之处。 举例来说,AID 1885在网络界面中被报告为基于Cell,但在批量下载中被报告为基于Cell的QQOOrganism. 此外,在单一的PubChem条目中可能出现不一致之处:同一描述可能与多个相互冲突的BAO标签相关. 从大量BARD下载的PubChem上标有BARD和CHEMBL分析格式标签的236份化验中,有24份化验有分歧(10.2%)。 进一步详情和案例研究见附录E.1。 此外,元数据的覆盖面有限。 PubChem批量下载的数据显示大量缺失数据,在190万条条目中,有36%的缺失了化验格式,而在注释中附加说明的具有BAO化验格式和物理检测方法的化验不到0.1%.

blocks.en: All in all, PubChem contains substantial bioassay annotation issues, including missing and inconsistent information.
blocks.zh: 总的来说,PubChem含有大量的生物分析注释问题,包括缺少和不一致的信息。

blocks.en: 5 Results: An LLM-based Auditing Workflow
blocks.zh: 页:1 结果:基于LLM的审计工作流程

blocks.en:
Given the missingness, heterogeneity, and inconsistencies identified in Section 4 , we evaluated whether LLMs could provide a scalable approach to reviewing and assigning bioassay metadata labels. Model predictions were compared against existing annotations derived from PubChem, ChEMBL, and BARD, which we refer to as silver labels.
Because these references may themselves be incomplete, inconsistent, or erroneous, the per-class classification metrics reported below should not be interpreted as definitive annotation accuracy. To mitigate these limitations, we manually inspect a subset, keeping in mind that annotations from different sources might differ in trustworthiness.
blocks.zh:
鉴于第4节所查明的缺失、异质性和不一致之处,我们评价了有限责任公司是否可以提供一种可扩展的方法来审查和分配生物测定元数据标签。 模型预测被与来自PubChem,CHEMBL,和BARD的现有说明相比较,我们称之为银色标签.
由于这些参考本身可能不完整、不一致或错误,下文报告的每类分类衡量标准不应被解释为明确的注释准确性。 为了减轻这些限制,我们手动检查一个子集,同时铭记不同来源的说明在可信度上可能有所不同。

blocks.en: 5.1 Reliability against silver sources
blocks.zh: 5.1 对银源的可靠性

blocks.en: We first assess agreement among the LLMs using Cohen’s κ \kappa [ 5 ] . On the ChEMBL assay format evaluation set, all seven LLMs achieve pairwise Cohen’s κ > 0.9 \kappa>0.9 , with similar agreement on the BAO detection tasks. The agreement drops on the smaller PubChem-BAO subset, but is still high with κ > 0.8 \kappa>0.8 for all models except Gemma 3 27B, where we see lower agreement with the other LLMs. Full agreement matrices for all three experiments along with a definition of the Cohen’s κ \kappa are provided in Appendix G .
blocks.zh: 我们首先用科恩的\kappa 来评估LLMs之间的协议。 在ChEMBL测试格式评价集上,所有7个LLMs都实现了双向Cohen ob > 0.9\kappa>0.9,在BAO检测任务上也有类似的协议. 协议在较小的PubChem-BAO子集上下降,但除Gemma 3 27B外,除Gemma 3 27B型外,其它LLMs的一致程度较低,与ob > 0.8\kappa > 0.8型号仍然很高. 附录G提供了所有三项试验的完全一致的矩阵以及Cohen ox kappa的定义。

blocks.en:
Next, we evaluate whether the consensus signal tracks silver-label sources, using ChEMBL assay format labels as a reference. Table 1 reports classification metrics for each assay format class. A majority voting consensus of LLMs agrees with the ChEMBL label in 96 % \% of the cases. Cell-based and biochemical format are classified consistently well with a recall at least 96% for all models including the open-source ones. Performance on the organism-based format varies more across models: Gemma 3 27B achieves the highest precision, but makes the fewest predictions for this class. The majority vote achieves a recall of 87% on the organism-based format with a precision of 77%, noticeably lower than the performance on the cell-based and biochemical format. The cell-free and tissue-based formats show substantially lower precision and recall for all models, with at most one correctly predicted instance in either class. These results might suggest that LLMs are unreliable for rare assay format classes (only 6 and 2 entries in this dataset). However,
manual inspection showed that for 7 out of 8 of these assays the BARD label was actually different from the ChEMBL label and LLMs agreed with the BARD label and for the last, the expert curator agreed with the LLM prediction. We will elaborate on this in the following paragraph.

人工检查表明,在其中的8项检验中,有7项的BARD标签实际上不同于ChEMBL标签,LLMs同意BARD标签,最后,专家主管同意LLM预测。 我们将在下面的段落中阐述这一点。

blocks.en: We further inspected the 43 assays in which the majority of models disagreed with the ChEMBL label in Appendix H . For 29 of these assays, PubChem BARD labels are also available. As we show in Table 2 , out of these, in 17 cases (59 % \% ) the LLM consensus agreed with the BARD PubChem label but not ChEMBL. This finding is particularly notable because BARD annotations are generated through a comparatively thorough process that includes additional verification not applied to the ChEMBL labels. For the cases in which ChEMBL and BARD agreed, but LLMs did not, further inspection showed that the models did not unanimously disagree on the ChEMBL label (for full details see Appendix Table 12 ). If the ChEMBL label is correct in these instances, a structured debate among models could potentially help resolve the disagreement.

blocks.en: For 17 assay AIDs, we conducted a further manual review by asking domain experts to classify each assay. We included all assays for which the ChEMBL and PubChem BARD labels agreed but the LLM consensus differed. In addition, we randomly selected four cases in which the LLM consensus agreed with the PubChem BARD label but disagreed with the ChEMBL label. We also included cases in which the LLM consensus disagreed with both the ChEMBL and BARD labels.
blocks.zh: 对于17个分析助理数据,我们进行了进一步的人工审查,要求域专家对每一项分析进行分类。 我们列入了所有证据,这些证据是CHEMBL和PubChem BARD标签所同意的,但LLM共识有所不同。 此外,我们随机选择了四个案例,其中LLM共识同意PubChem BARD标签,但不同意ChEMBL标签. 我们还列入了LLM共识不同意CEMBL和BARD标签的情况。

blocks.en: We shared with the expert annotator the same information as with the LLMs: title, description, comment and protocol. Experts highlighted that classifying these examples was challenging. In 6 cases they agreed with the majority of LLMs immediately. In further six cases, they agreed after seeing the evidence provided by the LLMs. In four additional cases, the experts considered the LLM classification plausible—three of them after reviewing the model-provided evidence—but did not assign a definitive label. They noted that some assays could reasonably fit multiple classes or lacked sufficient information for an unambiguous classification. These observations suggest that uncertainty or multiple applicable labels may be worth representing explicitly in the database.
blocks.zh: 我们与专家注释员分享了与法学硕士相同的信息:标题、描述、评论和协议。 专家们强调,对这些例子进行分类具有挑战性。 在6起案件中,他们立即同意大多数法学硕士。 在另外6起案件中,他们在看到LLMs提供的证据后表示同意。 在另外四起案件中,专家们认为LLM分类是可信的,其中三起是在审查了模型提供的证据之后进行的,但没有指定明确的标签。 他们指出,一些化验可以合理地适合多个类别,或者缺乏充分的资料,无法进行明确的分类。 这些意见表明,不确定性或多种适用的标签可能值得在数据库中明确表示。

blocks.en:
We realized that the annotator initially placed substantial weight on the format type stated in the assay title, for which in many cases they changed their mind after seeing LLM evidence. For example, for AID 2695, the title was “Fluorescence Cell-Based Dose Screen to Determine Inhibitors of C. albicans Viability”. The expert prediction was cell-based and the LLM predicted organism format.
Upon closer inspection, and after reviewing the LLMs’ reasoning, the expert concluded that the LLM classification was correct. The expert had initially overlooked the fact that, according to the official BAO definition, “single-celled organisms” should be classified as an organism format. This could be a result of the discrepancy between the assay format and the BAO assay format on ChEMBL. Finally, for assay AID 588769, the LLMs identified a likely mislabeled datapoint in PubChem and agreed with the expert’s classification. For AID 1470, the expert considered the classification highly uncertain; nevertheless, the expert’s assessment was consistent with the LLM consensus and differed from both the ChEMBL and PubChem labels, providing further evidence of alignment between the LLMs and human judgement.
blocks.zh:
我们意识到,注释员最初相当重视分析标题中所述的格式类型,在许多情况下,他们在看到LLM证据后改变了主意。 例如,对AID 2695来说,标题是“以荧光细胞为基础的剂量屏幕,以确定C. albicans活性性的干扰者”。 专家预测以细胞为基础,LLM预测有机体格式.
专家在仔细检查并审查了LLM的推理之后得出结论,LLM分类是正确的。 专家最初忽略了一个事实,即根据BAO的官方定义,“单细胞生物”应归类为一种生物形式。 这可能是CHEMBL上的化验格式与BAO化验格式不一致的结果。 最后,就AID 588769而言,LLMs在PubChem发现了一个可能贴错了标签的数据点,并同意专家的分类。 专家认为AID 1470的分类非常不确定;然而,专家的评估与LLM共识一致,与ChEMBL和PubChem标签不同,进一步证明了LLMs与人类判断的一致性。

blocks.en: Together, these cases suggest that, when grounded in BAO definitions, LLM predictions may help identify errors in both database annotations and initial expert assessments. However, this capability was not consistent across all cases. For AID 504631, the expert agreed with the ChEMBL label rather than with the label supported by the LLM consensus. The expert correctly noted that the assay used a living organism, whereas the LLMs frequently confused this category with a cell-line format (see Appendix H ). Thus, although the LLMs identified the relevant evidence, they drew the wrong conclusion from it.
blocks.zh: 这些情况表明,如果基于BAO的定义,LLM预测可能有助于查明数据库说明和初步专家评估中的错误。 然而,这种能力并非在所有情况下都是一致的。 关于AID 504631,专家同意CHEMBL标签,而不是LLM共识支持的标签。 专家正确地指出,化验使用了活生物体,而LLMs经常将这一类与细胞线格式混淆(见附录H)。 因此,虽然LLMS确定了相关证据,但他们从中得出了错误的结论。

blocks.en: To follow up on this, we conducted a second experiment where we used the third-party BAO annotations already available in PubChem. In Table 3 we observe again LLM agreement with BARD labels compared to third party PubChem annotations. In the majority of cases where the BARD label did not align with the third party BAO assay format, LLMs agree with BARD. This highlights that there is a lack of consensus on what the ground truth should be.
blocks.zh: 为此,我们进行了第二次试验,使用了已在PubChem提供的第三方BAO说明。 在表3中,与第三方PubChem说明相比,我们再次观察到与BARD标签的LLM协议。 在BARD标签与第三方BAO分析格式不一致的大多数情况下,LLMs同意BARD. 这突出表明,在何为真相的问题上缺乏共识。

blocks.en: 5.2 Extending to a Second BAO Axis: Detection Technology
blocks.zh: 5.2 扩展至第二个BAO轴:检测技术

blocks.en: To test whether our auditing workflow generalizes beyond a single BAO axis, we repeated the analysis on the physical detection technology axis. BAO’s detection hierarchy contains 12 classes, compared to 6 in assay format, at the depth-one level. Moreover, ChEMBL provides fewer cross-referenced labels, so we treat these results as a complementary probe.
blocks.zh: 为了测试我们的审计工作流程是否超出单一BAO轴线,我们重复了对物理检测技术轴线的分析. BAO的检测等级包括12个等级,而6个等级为深度一级。 此外,CHEMBL提供的交叉参照标签较少,因此我们将这些结果视为一个互补的探针.

blocks.en: Table 4 reports the precision and recall per class. LLMs achieve high recall on most categories, including fluorescence, luminescence and radiometry. The performance on spectrophotometry is more moderate, with the mass spectrometry results and label-free methods having too few labels to draw definitive conclusions. Again, we see no big differences between open-source and proprietary models.
blocks.zh: 表4按类别报告准确性和召回性。 在大多数类别,包括荧光、发光和辐射测量方面,LLMs都实现了较高的召回率。 光谱学上的性能较为温和,质谱学结果和无标签方法的标签太少,无法得出明确的结论. 同样,我们看到开源模型和专有模型之间没有很大的区别。

blocks.en: To understand if the performance against silver labels is representative, and whether other questionable entries in PubChem might benefit from further review, we manually inspected 34 assays where the majority of LLMs disagreed with the label. BARD disagreed with the third-party annotation in the bulk download in all 24 cases where a BARD annotation was available. In 15 out of these 24 cases, our LLMs agreed with BARD, highlighting that the predictions that disagreed with the "silver" truth might be predominantly attributable to inaccuracies in the silver labels rather than genuine model error.
blocks.zh: 为了了解对照银色标签的性能是否具有代表性,以及PubChem的其他可疑条目是否可从进一步审查中受益,我们手动检查了34项化验,其中大多数LLMs不同意标签。 在有BARD注释的所有24个案件中,BARD不同意批量下载中的第三方注释。 在这24起案件中的15起中,我们的法学硕士同意BARD的意见,强调不同意“银”真理的预测可能主要归因于银牌上的不准确,而不是真正的模型错误。

blocks.en: A recurring source of ambiguity was the occurrence of assay-supporting methods, such as "quantitative reverse transcription PCR" and "cell number determination," which do not map cleanly onto any BAO physical detection method subcategory. LLMs variably placed such assays under simple measurement, visual observation, or a physically-adjacent readout method (e.g., fluorescence, when the underlying chemistry, such as TaqMan, is fluorescent based), suggesting that forcing LLMs to output a single physical detection method is suboptimal for some assays.
blocks.zh: 反复出现的模棱两可的根源是实验支持方法的出现,如"定量反转式PCR"和"细胞数测定",这些方法并不能将图像清晰地映射到任何BAO物理检测方法子类上. LLMs将此类化验置于简单的测量,视觉观察,或物理上相邻的读取方法(例如荧光,当基础化学如TaqMan基于荧光时)下,说明强迫LLMs输出一种单一的物理检测方法对于某些化验来说是不理想的.

blocks.en: There was one AID (1259354) with the notation “AlphaLISA: fluorescence intensity” in the assay dataset. We were unsure of whether AlphaLISA should be in the fluorescence methods, the luminescence method or the proximity-based method. All our LLMs tested agreed that it should be the luminescence method, which given the alphascreen method being in that category, could be reasonable.
blocks.zh: 分析数据集中有一个AID(1259354)加注了“AlphaLISA:荧光强度”。 我们不确定AlphaLISA是否应该采用荧光法、发光法或近距离法。 我们所有经测试的LLMS都同意,应该采用发光法,因为阿尔法屏法属于这一类别,因此这种方法是合理的。

blocks.en: To probe whether the remaining disagreements between BARD or ChEMBL and the LLMs could be explained, we asked the expert curator to review 11 records. In 6 cases the expert judged the assay genuinely undefinable and in every one of these, non-erroring models likewise self-reported low confidence, evidence that models can recognize when a physical detection method truly cannot be determined from the text, even as they still emit a best-guess label. In a further 3 cases (588778, 624286, 651578), the expert’s own annotation explicitly named more than one acceptable detection method rather than a single ground truth: for 588778, the expert confirmed the assay genuinely uses both spectrophotometry (growth) and fluorescence (motility discrimination), while for 624286 and 651578 the expert accepted visual observation as one of several defensible labels for manual plaque counting.
blocks.zh: 为了调查能否解释BARD或CHEMBL与LLMs之间的其余分歧,我们请专家主管审查11项记录。 在6起案件中,专家判断了真实的不可界定性,在所有这些非腐蚀模型中,同样自报的低信任度模型,当物理检测方法确实无法从文字中确定时,模型就能够识别出证据,即使这些模型仍然发出最好的猜测。 在另外3起案件(58878、624286、651578)中,专家自己的注释明确命名了一种以上可接受的检测方法,而不是单一的地面真理:对于588778人,专家确认,该证词真实地使用了光谱测量(生长)和荧光(机动性歧视)两种方法,而对于624286和651578人,专家接受了视觉观察,将其作为人工计牌的几个可辨识标签之一。

blocks.en: Only 2 of the 11 assays remain cases of true single-label disagreement: for AID 623918, the expert’s chosen label (simple measurement) matched the model majority (4 of 7 models) against the label in BARD. For AID 623968, the expert’s label (spectrophotometry) was tied 3–3 among non-error models against fluorescence, reflecting a genuine two-step-protocol ambiguity (RNA quantification by absorbance vs. RT-PCR detection via TaqMan fluorescence) rather than an outright model error. For the full analysis we refer to Appendix I .
blocks.zh: 在11项化验中,只有2项仍然存在真正的单一标签分歧:对于AID 623918来说,专家选择的标签(简单测量)与BARD的标签相对应的是模型多数(7种模型中的4种)。 对AID 623968来说,该专家的标签(光谱测量)被捆绑在防荧光的非腐蚀模型中,反映出真正的两步-标本模糊(RNA通过吸收对RT-PCR通过Taqman荧光检测),而不是完全的模型错误。 关于全面分析,请参阅附录一。

blocks.en: 5.3 Calibrated confidence and Prompt Ablations
blocks.zh: 5.3 校准信心和迅速损坏

blocks.en: Intrigued by the finding that all the LLMs labelled the assay which the expert labeled as “cannot define” with low confidence, we examined the relationship between LLM-reported confidence and correctness against the silver label (see Appendix J ). For the 1097 ChEMBL datapoints, over all the seven LLMs tried, we saw that for the medium confidence labels given by Claude and GPT-OSS 20B, the disagreement rate at 33% and 100% was much higher than for the instances predicted high confidence and a disagreement rate of only up to 5%. For the detection task we saw more spread confidence. On the high confidence labels there is a disagreement rate of up to only 10%, with higher disagreement for the medium high labels and low confidence labels. It is also noteworthy that only Claude Sonnet 4.6 and GPT-OSS 20B model use the medium confidence, though other models give low confidence to some of their predictions as well. Combined with reasoning traces, this enables a practical triage: high-confidence predictions that agree with BARD can be accepted; high-confidence disagreements are surfaced with their supporting evidence for human review; and low-confidence predictions are routed to curators along with the model’s reasoning. Nevertheless, further verification is necessary, especially since these are disagreement rates against silver labels.
blocks.zh: 令人感兴趣的是,所有LLMs将专家贴上“不能定义”标签的化验结果都低信心地贴上了标签,我们审查了LLM报告的信任度与银色标签上的正确度之间的关系(见附录J)。 在1097个ChEMBL数据点中, 在所有7个LLMs的尝试中,我们看到克劳德和GPT-OSS 20B给出的中置信心标签中, 33%和100%的分歧率远高于预测的高置信心和5%的分歧率。 在探测任务方面,我们看到了更大的信心。 在高置信度标签上,分歧率只有10%,对中置高标签和低置信度标签的分歧较大. 还值得注意的是,只有Claude Sonnet 4.6和GPT-OSS 20B模型使用中度置信度,尽管其他模型也对其部分预测给予低度置信度. 再加上推理的痕迹,可以进行实际的分解:可以接受与BARD一致的高度自信预测;高度自信的分歧随其支持人类审查的证据而浮出水面;低自信的预测随模型的推理而归结于采集者。 尽管如此,还需要进一步核查,特别是因为这些是银牌的分歧率。

blocks.en:
Next to having a calibrated confidence, it is important that the LLMs predict based on the information given, not merely the order of the labels presented. To investigate the sensitivity of our results to prompt design, we evaluated
two perturbations of the baseline prompt on the ChEMBL assay format
subset. First the order swap where we reversed the alphabetical order of the initial experiment. Second, the format without definitions, which removed the BAO class definitions and only keeps the assay format labels. Results show that when swapping the order, labels change in less than 1.2% of the cases for proprietary models and 2.6% for the open-source models, indicating low ordering bias (see Appendix K ).
Removing the definitions, however, changes 3.1%, 10.8%, and 3.8% of predictions for
Claude Sonnet 4.6, Gemini 3.6 Flash, and GPT-4o respectively. Gemini in particular shows more changes away from the silver label, which implies that Gemini might rely more heavily on the in-prompt definitions. For the open-source models the change is 4.2% for Llama 3.3 70B, up to 8.8% for GPT-4o. Interestingly, without the definitions there are also a number of flips without the definitions towards the silver label. This could mimic the human pattern of guessing the definition and consequently assigning it to a certain (silver) label, without grounding it in the exact definition asked for.
blocks.zh:
除了有校准的信心外,LLMs还必须根据所提供的信息,而不仅仅是所呈现标签的顺序来预测。 为了调查我们的结果对迅速设计的敏感性,我们评价了
CEMBL 测定格式基准提示的两次扰动
子集。 首先我们把初始实验的字母顺序 倒置了 第二,没有定义的格式,它删除了BAO类定义,只保留了分析格式标签. 结果显示,在换订单时,专利模型的标签变化不到1.2%,开源模型的标签变化2.6%,表明订购偏差较低(见附录K)。
然而,删除这些定义将改变3.1%、10.8%和3.8%的预测。
克劳德·索内4.6,双子座3.6 Flash,和GPT-4o分别是. 特别是双子座显示银色标签的改变更多,这意味着双子座可能更依赖即时定义. 对于开源模型,Llama 3.3 70B的变化率为4.2%,GPT-4o的变化高达8.8%。 有趣的是,没有定义,也有一些没有定义的翻转,转向银色标签. 这可以模仿人类猜测定义的模式,从而将其划入某一(银)标签,而不以所要求的确切定义为依据。

blocks.en: 6 Discussion and Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6. 讨论和结论

blocks.en: Our audit indicates that PubChem’s bulk distribution offers incomplete assay metadata: roughly 36% of records lack an assay format, and fewer than 0.1% carry a structured BAO annotation. We also observe non-trivial disagreement across resources, 10% among the 236 assays with both BARD and ChEMBL format labels available in the bulk download. These gaps likely reflect the optional nature of several metadata fields at deposition time, together with the limited vocabulary of PubChem’s native Assay Format field relative to the richer BAO hierarchy.
blocks.zh: 我们的审计表明,PubChem的批量发行提供了不完整的检验元数据:大约36%的记录缺乏检验格式,不到0.1%的记录带有结构化的BAO注释。 我们还观察到不同资源之间的非三角分歧,在236项与BARD和CHEMBL格式标签的测试中,有10%是散装下载的。 这些空白可能反映了沉降时几个元数据字段的可选性,以及相对于较丰富的BAO结构,PubChem的本土Assay格式字段词汇有限.

blocks.en: To address this gap, we evaluated seven LLMs, both proprietary and open-source, and found that they agree strongly with each other and recover well-supported assay format classes with recall above 0.96. Manual inspection of the cases where LLMs disagreed with silver labels showed that these errors are frequently traceable to inconsistencies between sources, or to mislabeling, rather than to the models themselves: in over a third of cases where the majority LLM prediction disagreed with ChEMBL, the LLMs in fact aligned with the PubChem/BARD label, and our senior annotator revised their own labels in several cases after seeing the model’s cited evidence. Differences between proprietary and open-source models were small throughout, suggesting cheaper open-weight models are a viable option for annotation at scale, though at a cost of $3–9 to audit 1000 records even proprietary models are orders of magnitude cheaper than manual re-curation(Appendix L ).
blocks.zh: 为了弥补这一差距,我们评估了7个有限责任公司,包括专有和开源,发现它们彼此非常一致,并恢复了得到良好支持的化验格式类,召回次数超过0.96。 对LLMs不同意银色标签的个案进行人工检查表明,这些错误往往可以追溯到来源之间的不一致,或者错误地标注,而不是模型本身:在多数LLM预测与ChEMBL不相符的三分之一的个案中,LLMs实际上与PubChem/BARD标签一致,我们的高级注释员在看到模型引用的证据后修改了他们自己的标签。 专利模型和开源模型之间的差别始终很小,这表明更便宜的开放重量模型是规模说明的一个可行选择,尽管审计1000个记录的成本为3-9美元,即使是专利模型,其数量级也比人工再查要便宜(附录L)。

blocks.en: Taken together, results support a cautious claim that LLMs may improve upon individual existing annotations in cases of source disagreement. Based on this, we foresee a specific role for LLMs in the annotation pipeline, both as annotators and as auditors. LLMs flag inconsistent records, surface the textual evidence behind a disagreement, and route ambiguous cases to human curators, with per-class reliability estimates attached before any label is allowed to enter a downstream ML pipeline.
blocks.zh: 总之,结果支持一种谨慎的说法,即有限责任公司在出现来源分歧的情况下,可以改进现有的个别说明。 在此基础上,我们预见到有限责任公司在说明中的具体作用,无论是作为注释员还是作为审计员。 LLMS标注不一致的记录,表面显示分歧背后的文字证据,将模棱两可的案件交给人类主管,在允许任何标签进入下游ML管道之前附上每类可靠性估计。

blocks.en: These findings and the proposed framing come with limitations that follow from our results, silver labels are only partially reliable, so recall computed against them should be read as agreement with existing curation, not as ground-truth accuracy; where BARD, ChEMBL, and PubChem disagree, recall figures for the “losing” source will look artificially low even when the model is correct. Moreover, our evaluation stays at BAO depth one, and the live PUG JSON endpoint, the only consistently up-to-date source, currently rate-limits exhaustive crawls, which constrained how deep and how broad our dataset could go when sticking to PubChem. Our qualitative validation also has its own limitations: expert review was conducted with a single senior curator, so our findings reflect one expert’s judgment rather than consensus across annotators.
blocks.zh: 这些调查结果和拟议框架都带有我们的结果所产生的局限性,银色标签只是部分可靠,因此根据这些标签计算的回扣应被理解为同意现有的校准,而不是地面真实的准确性;如果BARD、CEMBL和PubChem有不同意见,那么即使模型正确,回扣“丢失”来源的数字也会显得人为低。 此外,我们的评估仍然停留在BAO深度1,现场的PUG JSON端点是目前唯一一致的最新来源,其速率限制是详尽无遗的,这限制了我们数据集在坚持PubChem时的深度和宽度。 我们的质量鉴定也有其自身的局限性:专家审查是由一位资深主管进行的,因此我们的调查结果反映的是一位专家的判断,而不是对注释员的共识。

blocks.en: Finally, we identified one failure mode worth flagging explicitly: for AID 504631, several LLMs quoted the correct evidence (that Plasmodium falciparum is a single-celled organism) yet still defaulted to a cell-based label instead of organism-based . This shows that even high-confidence predictions backed by correct evidence can fail at the final step of mapping that evidence onto the BAO class definitions, and argues for continued human spot-checking of whether the cited evidence actually supports the assigned label in these known tricky cases.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们明确确定了一种值得标注的失败模式:对于AID 504631, 几个LLMs引用了正确的证据(恶性疟原虫是单细胞生物), 这表明,即使有正确证据支持的高度自信预测也可能在将证据映射到BAO类定义的最后一步中失败,并主张继续由人现场检查所引用的证据是否确实支持这些已知棘手案件中的指定标签。

blocks.en: Beyond auditing existing annotations, the process itself surfaced gaps in BAO: the ontology currently lacks a definition for the “biosensor” detection technology, and the definitions of “simple measurement” and “visual observation” methods proved ambiguous enough to divide both LLMs and our expert curator. This suggests that LLM-based auditing can feed back into ontology maintenance, not only into data curation.
blocks.zh: 除了审计现有说明外,程序本身在BAO中也出现了差距:本体学目前缺乏对“生物传感器”探测技术的定义,“简单测量”和“视像观测”方法的定义被证明是模糊不清的,足以将LLMs和我们的专家主管区分开来。 这表明基于LLM的审计可以反馈到肿瘤学的维护中,而不仅仅是数据解析.

blocks.en:
As next steps, we would like to experiment with deeper BAO granularity where support permits, expanding the dataset that we test on, utilize industrial datasets and LLM-mediated
debate to resolve residual silver-label conflicts, ingredients we believe necessary to bring legacy bioassay repositories to the readiness that foundation models for molecular property prediction now demand.
blocks.zh:
作为下一步,我们希望在支助允许的情况下试验更深的BAO颗粒性,扩大我们测试的数据集,利用工业数据集和LLM介导
解决残留的银质标签冲突的辩论,我们认为,为使遗留的生物测定储存库具备目前分子财产预测的基础模型所需要的条件,这些要素是必要的。

System prompt — Baseline Assay Format Prompt You are an expert curator working with the BioAssay Ontology (BAO), a
structured vocabulary used by ChEMBL and PubChem to standardize how
bioassay experiments are described. The category definitions below are
taken directly from BAO’s official class definitions. Given the Description , Comment , and Protocol of a bioassay record (when available), classify its assay format into
exactly one of the following categories, based on the BioAssay
Ontology (BAO). Categories (with definitions and typical phrasing you may see): 1. biochemical format An in vitro format used to
measure the activity of a biological macromolecule (purified
protein or nucleic acid). Most often homogeneous, but can be
heterogeneous when a solid phase (e.g. beads) immobilizes the
macromolecule. Subcategories: protein format, nucleic acid
format, protein complex format, single protein format . 2. cell-based format Uses living cells of eukaryotic
origin, derived from a multicellular organism; heterogeneous
assay type. Typically permanent (immortal) cell lines, primary
cells, or stem cells. Distinct from single-celled organism-based
formats (e.g. bacteria, yeast). Subcategory: Transwell
chamber format . 3. cell-free format Originates from a cell but does not
use intact (live) cells; excludes biochemical assays. Usually
homogeneous; heterogeneous when components are bead-immobilized.
Subcategories: subcellular, whole cell lysate, plasma,
serum, blood, nucleosome, cell membrane, cytosol, microsome,
mitochondrion, nuclear extract, lysate-based, liposome, S9
fraction, tissue membrane, synaptosomal fraction, rabbit
reticulocyte lysate, synaptosomal P2 fraction . 4. organism-based format Uses a living organism, single
or multi-celled; heterogeneous assay type. 5. tissue-based format Uses a tissue derived from a
living organism; heterogeneous assay type. Rules: • Use the strongest evidence across all provided fields. • If multiple categories seem plausible, pick the one most
directly supported by explicit terminology in the text,
not inferred biology. • Respond with valid JSON only — no markdown, no extra
text. Output format: {"bao_format": "<cell-based format|biochemical format|
                 organism-based format|tissue-based format|
                 cell-free format>",
 "confidence": "<high|medium|low>",
 "evidence": "<short quote or paraphrase from the text
              that supports your choice>"}

blocks.zh: E.1 联合国 关于PubChem中注解不一致的案例研究

blocks.en: To illustrate the annotation inconsistencies summarized in Section 4 , in this section we discuss two representative case studies provide further statistics on the BARD-ChEMBL cross-source disagreements.
blocks.zh: 为了说明第4节概述的注释不一致之处,在本节中,我们讨论两个有代表性的个案研究,就BARD-CHEMBL的交叉来源分歧提供进一步的统计数字。

blocks.en: AID 1885 is reported as Cell-based in the PubChem web interface, but as Cell-based|Organism-based in the bulk download. Although it is difficult to determine exactly how BioAssay Types are annotated, the protocol and description could plausibly support both categories: the assay runs in mouse fibroblasts (suggesting a cell-based format), while the target is a living microorganism (which could suggest an organism-based format). According to the BAO, however, the organism-based format label refers only to intact living organisms 9 9 9 https://bioportal.bioontology.org/ontologies/BAO?p=classes&conceptid=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.bioassayontology.org%2Fbao%23BAO_0000218 , so it should not apply here since no intact organism was used. The PubChem web interface correctly displays only the cell-based annotation. The same ambiguity likely affects the other 42 entries carrying Cell-based|Organism-based annotations in PubChem, as well as many further combinations such as In Vitro|Organism-based .
blocks.zh: AID 1885在PubChem网络界面中被报告为基于Cell,但在批量下载中作为基于Cell的QQOrganism. 虽然很难确切地确定生物测定类型是如何附加注释的,但协议和描述可以合理地支持这两个类别:实验以鼠标纤维拉片(建议细胞格式)运行,而目标则是活的微生物(可以建议一种基于生物的格式). 但根据BAO,基于有机体的格式标签只指完好无损的生物 9 9 9 https://bioportal.bioontology.org/ontologies/BAO?p=classe&concontentid=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.bioassayontology.org%2Fbao%23BAO_000218,因此不应在此应用,因为没有使用完好无损的生物体. PubChem网络界面只正确显示基于单元格的注释. 同样的模糊性可能影响PubChem中载有基于Cell的QQOOrganism的注释的其他42个条目,以及许多进一步的组合,如基于VitroQOrganism的组合.

blocks.en: Next to annotations from external sources, PubChem also displays assay annotations obtained from third-party sources, and these do not always agree with each other or with the BARD annotations. Furthermore, the BARD-linked bulk download 10 10 10 See https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/source/BioAssay%20Research%20Database%20(BARD) . does not cover all BARD-annotated assays shown on PubChem. AID 588585 presents an example for this. It is labelled “biochemical” under the categorised-comment BAO field but “subcellular” in the BARD-derived BioAssay Annotations tab, despite not appearing in the BARD bulk download at all. blocks.en: H.1 Failure case: AID 504631

A notable disagreement concerned assay AID 504631 using the single-celled pathogens Plasmodium falciparum . Under the BAO ontology, cell-based format is explicitly restricted to eukaryotic cells derived from a multicellular organism (cell lines, primary cells, stem cells) and is explicitly distinguished from organism-based format , which covers any living organism, single- or multi-celled. Bacteria and yeast are given as the canonical single-celled examples. A single-celled eukaryotic parasite such as P. falciparum therefore falls under organism-based , not cell-based , even though it is eukaryotic and is cultured in wells.
blocks.zh: 一个显著的分歧涉及使用单细胞病原体的AID 504631。 在BAO本体学下,细胞基格式被明确限制在由多细胞生物(细胞线,原生细胞,干细胞)衍生的eukaryotic细胞上,并明确区别于生物基格式,它涵盖任何活体,单细胞或多细胞. 细菌和酵母被作为犬科单细胞的例子给出. 因此,单细胞卵巢寄生虫,如P.疟原虫,属于基于有机物的,而不是基于细胞的,尽管是卵巢寄生虫,在井中培养。

blocks.en: Table 14 shows model predictions for AID 504631, “A cell-based HTS for delayed death inhibitors of the malarial parasite”. Four of seven models (Gemma 3 27B, GPT-OSS 20B, GPT-4o, Llama 3.3 70B) predicted cell-based format with high confidence, while three (Claude, Gemini, Gemma 4 31B) correctly predicted organism-based format . Notably, the erroneous predictions are not due to missing information: the cited evidence in several cases (e.g., GPT-OSS 20B, Llama 3.3 70B) directly quotes text referring to “the malarial parasite” or a “microorganism system,” yet the models still defaulted to cell-based . This suggests the failure is not one of information retrieval but of ontological reasoning: models appear to pattern-match on surface cues such as “cells cultured in wells” or the word “parasite” co-occurring with “cell,” rather than applying the BAO-specific distinction. The assay’s own title (“cell-based HTS”) likely reinforces this bias, as several models’ cited evidence draws directly on title wording rather than the underlying biology.
blocks.zh: 表14显示了AID 504631“疟疾寄生虫延迟死亡抑制剂的细胞HTS”模型预测。 7个模型中有4个(Gemma 3 27B,GPT-OSS 20B,GPT-4o,Llama 3.3 70B)以高度的置信度预测细胞格式,而3个模型(Claude,双子座,Gemma 4 31B)正确预测了基于有机体的格式. 值得注意的是,错误的预测并非由于缺少信息所致:在几个案例中(如GPT-OSS 20B,Llama 3.3 70B)引用的证据直接引用了提及“疟疾寄生虫”或“微生物系统”的文字,但模型仍然默认为基于细胞的。 这表明失败不是信息检索,而是本体推理的失败:模型似乎在表面提示上出现模式匹配,例如“井中培养的细胞”或“参数”一词与“细胞”共同出现,而不是适用BAO特有的区别。 证据本身的标题(“基于细胞的HTS”)可能强化这种偏见,因为一些模型所引用的证据直接引用的是标题措词,而不是基本生物学。
